title: Orca lab scheduler 2.0 adds daemon and REST API, relicenses to SSPL
summary: Cheshire Labs' Orca, a Python scheduler for lab workflows, moved to a persistent local daemon with REST/SSE interface and CLI in v2.0.0. The same release relicensed it from AGPL-3.0 to the Server Side Public License.

claims.text: v2.0.0 replaces 1.x authoring with four decorators; workflows stay plain Python
'Relicensed from AGPL-3.0 to the Server Side Public License, version 1'; releases up to v1.0.0 stay AGPL-3.0

why_it_matters: Open schedulers are maturing, but SSPL is not OSI-approved open source, so pharma legal teams may treat it differently.

title: Orca 2.3.0 adds simulation time-scaling and audit reasons for scheduler actions
summary: Orca 2.3.0 lets simulated runs be paced faster than real time and writes ten more operator actions to an audit log, with an optional reason. Labware barcodes must now be unique.

claims.text: Simulation time scale: 1 real time, 0.1 ten times faster, 0 no pacing; LIVE runs reject it
Ten more operator actions write audit rows; audited actions accept an optional reason
Two labware cannot share a barcode (409 barcode_in_use)

why_it_matters: Audit rows and barcode checks are the kind of traceability a regulated ADME lab needs from any scheduler; Orca is still early-stage.

title: PyLabRobot merges work-in-progress Kingfisher magnetic-particle processor support
summary: PyLabRobot pull request 1570, merged 3 November, adds work-in-progress support for the Kingfisher Presto, a magnetic-bead sample processor.
why_it_matters: Small driver addition; bead-based sample prep is more relevant to genomics than ADME.
